choose.intro: Export the statement from your bank's app or website in OFX format and choose the file here.
choose.privacy: The file is read only on this device and is not uploaded. You review the transactions, and only the ones you confirm go into {{appName}}.
choose.where: It is usually under Statement → Export (or Share) → OFX. Some banks call it “Money” or “Quicken”. Works with checking account and credit card statements.

errors.tooBig: The file is larger than 1 MB. Export a shorter period.
errors.notOfx: This file is not an OFX statement. Export it again choosing the OFX format.
errors.nothingValid: No transaction in the file has a valid date and amount.
errors.tooMany: The file has {{total}} transactions, and the limit is {{max}} at a time. Export a shorter period.
errors.read: The file could not be read.

review.summary_zero: {{count}} transactions from {{from}} to {{to}}, in the file <file/>.
review.summary_one: {{count}} transaction from {{from}} to {{to}}, in the file <file/>.
review.summary_other: {{count}} transactions from {{from}} to {{to}}, in the file <file/>.
review.skipped_zero: {{count}} lines of the file were left out, without a valid date or amount.
review.skipped_one: {{count}} line of the file was left out, without a valid date or amount.
review.skipped_other: {{count}} lines of the file were left out, without a valid date or amount.
review.rules_zero: {{count}} categories filled in by your rules. You can change each line.
review.rules_one: {{count}} category filled in by your rules. You can change each line.
review.rules_other: {{count}} categories filled in by your rules. You can change each line.
review.transferNotice: Card bill payments, savings boxes and investments show up in the statement as money out, but they are not spending: if you also record the card purchases or keep the money in a vault, they would count twice. That is why these lines come unchecked.
review.similarNotice: “Similar” lines have the same date and amount as a transaction you already have. They come unchecked so nothing is duplicated.

done.skipped_zero: {{count}} had already been imported and were left out.
